why_not_run: The J3D authority gates J3D-B on J3D-A returning HARMONIC_MOVEMENT_DERIVABLE_FROM_CHROMA or HARMONIC_MOVEMENT_INCREMENTAL. It returned HARMONIC_MOVEMENT_INCONCLUSIVE. No render was produced and no visual claim is made.
what_this_file_is: A read of the already-pinned effect-semantics authority, which the J3D authority requires to be consumed BEFORE any rendering. Reading the pin is not running J3D-B. This is decision input for Captain.

the_only_pinned_harmonic_binding.why_verbatim_from_the_pin: Native chroma read. Product palette path (K1_Ultraviolet_Bright, chromatic_mode=false) made hue_centroid a weak HOST observable. Do not treat palette-locked hue as a chroma test.

the_grammar_status.note_verbatim: Native chroma mapping exists. Host hue is not a chroma test under product palette.
the_grammar_status.for_contrast: six of the eight pinned grammars are `represented` at HOST_PIXEL_VALIDATED; macro_transition is a declared GAP; harmonic_colour is the only `partial` one.

the_obstacle_this_creates_for_a_future_J.statement: The single pinned candidate carrier for harmonic information cannot presently be validated as a hue test, because the shipping palette path locks hue and makes hue_centroid a weak HOST observable. That obstacle is recorded in the pin itself and predates this job.
the_obstacle_this_creates_for_a_future_J.consequence: a future J3D-B would most likely return HARMONIC_VISUAL_GRAMMAR_GAP unless the palette path changes - and changing it is a production firmware change, which the J3D authority forbids in this job.
the_obstacle_this_creates_for_a_future_J.second_surface_named_in_the_pin_but_not_: mode 29 tempo_river_walk is described under the transport_phase grammar as 'same transport + bar-stepped palette (harmonic, not macro)'. It is a prose mention inside another grammar's `also` list, NOT a descriptor x mode x lever row. It must not be treated as an available binding without a pin update.
explicitly_not_done_here: no binding was named as available
harmonic movement was NOT bound to an acoustically driven lever for convenience

what_this_means_for_the_programme.layer: This is an L6/L7 finding, not an L2/L3 one. Even if harmonic movement is established as incremental musical state, the current K1 visual grammar has no validated carrier for it.
what_this_means_for_the_programme.value: That is a genuine and useful result: it says the constraint on harmonic intelligence is presently the visual grammar, not the perception.
what_this_means_for_the_programme.does_not_close: harmonic movement as a construct, harmonic intelligence as a family, or the possibility that a future mode provides the carrier.
